title: CLI and Utility Scripts
summary: This module provides command-line interface tools and various utility scripts for testing, maintenance, and cloud integration verification within the AI framework.

nodes.label: Run CLAI CLI
nodes.title: Execute CLAI CLI
nodes.description: Initializes and runs the main command-line interface for the CLAI application, handling program exit.

nodes.label: Validate CLI Help Output
nodes.title: Verify CLI Help in README
nodes.description: Compares the `clai --help` output with the content in `README.md` to ensure consistency and updates the README if discrepancies are found, failing the test if changes are detected.

nodes.label: Check VCR Cassettes
nodes.title: Identify Orphaned VCR Cassettes
nodes.description: Scans test modules to find VCR cassettes and their corresponding tests. Reports any 'orphaned' cassettes that do not have a matching test, helping to identify dead code or missing tests.

nodes.label: Upload Test Files to Providers
nodes.title: Upload Files for Provider Tests
nodes.description: Asynchronously uploads test files to various AI model providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Bedrock) to prepare for integration testing. Supports a configurable list of providers.

nodes.label: Verify Vertex GCS URIs
nodes.title: Test Vertex AI with GCS URIs
nodes.description: Verifies the functionality of Vertex AI models when provided with Google Cloud Storage (GCS) URIs for different file types, printing project and location details.

nodes.label: Verify Vertex GCS All Types
nodes.title: Test Vertex AI Tool Results with GCS
nodes.description: Extends GCS URI verification to cover various file types within Vertex AI tool results, ensuring robust integration with Google Cloud Storage.

nodes.label: Test Vertex GCS Tool Result
nodes.title: Validate Vertex AI Tool Results with GCS
nodes.description: Tests Vertex AI's ability to handle tool results that include Google Cloud Storage (GCS) URIs, both embedded in function responses and as separate file data parts, using the `google.genai` client.

groups.label: CLI Tools
groups.title: Command-Line Interface Tools
groups.description: Components related to the main command-line interface and its validation.

groups.label: Testing Utilities
groups.title: General Testing and Maintenance Utilities
groups.description: Scripts for maintaining test integrity, such as checking for orphaned test assets.

groups.label: Cloud Integration Verification
groups.title: Cloud Provider Integration and Verification
groups.description: Scripts dedicated to uploading test data and verifying AI model interactions with cloud storage and services, particularly Google Cloud Vertex AI.
